name: 3P - partner strip
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3P - partner strip.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: A native collection preview, not fulfillment integration. Use a collection/tag containing only the intended partner products and enter accurate delivery copy. Filtering and local price/date sorting inspect at most the first 50 products supplied by Shopify. The collection link opens the full tagged/sorted catalog; Shopify can redirect unused tags.

settings.label: Enable section
settings.how: Turn on “Enable section” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Section aria-label
settings.how: Enter the section aria-label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Kicker
settings.how: Enter the kicker. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Heading
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Body text
settings.default: Browse this selection and check individual product pages for current delivery information.
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Shipping note
settings.how: Enter the shipping note. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Partner / network name
settings.how: Enter the partner / network name. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Badge text
settings.how: Enter the badge text. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Show partner logo
settings.how: Turn on “Show partner logo” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Partner logo
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Product collection
settings.how: Choose an existing collection. Manage its products, title, image, and description under Products > Collections.

settings.label: Filter by product tag (optional)
settings.how: Enter the filter by product tag (optional). Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Max products to show
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust max products to show. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Preview sort order
settings.info: Price/newest sorts apply within the preview. Best selling requires the collection’s native order to be Best selling.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for preview sort order. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Layout style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Background style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for background style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Content alignment
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for content alignment. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Show "view all" link
settings.how: Turn on “Show "view all" link” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: "View all" label
settings.how: Enter the "view all" label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: "View all" link destination
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for "view all" link destination. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Custom "view all" URL
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.
